text:
[LTAC.4.3] If the parent rule fires N times before any of its
timer-fact retractions take effect, N independent timer facts
exist concurrently. Each carries its own `fire_at` and is matched
by an independent follow-up activation.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__alphas
idris.note: THE ALPHAS: the timer schema and the trigger schema. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__both_gone
idris.note: Both timers gone, the triggers alone remaining. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__independent_counts
idris.note: INDEPENDENT: the parent fires once per trigger; the follow-up fires for the first timer at 2 and the second at 4, each on its own tick and once. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__inputs
idris.note: Two triggers before any timer retraction takes effect, then the ticks. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__program
idris.note: THE PROGRAM: both rules, every kind explicit. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__rules
idris.note: THE PARENT AND ITS FOLLOW-UP: the follow-up on the timer schema; the parent on the trigger schema, its RHS the timer's assertion. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__timed
idris.note: THE TIMED TESTS, by ordinal: the follow-up's gate; the parent untimed. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__two_timers
idris.note: N TIMERS FROM N PARENT FIRINGS: after the two triggers are pumped, two timer facts are live concurrently, each with its own `fire_at`. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_3_5__capture_key
idris.note: Each timer carries its own trigger's key: what makes two timers of one site distinguishable. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__independent_timed
idris.note: N TIMERS FROM N PARENT FIRINGS, EACH ON ITS OWN TICK: the trigger `a` pumped at 0 arms a timer stamped 0; the advance to 2, the trigger `b` and a pump arm a second, stamped 2; the advance to 3 and a pump fire the first follow-up alone; the advance to 5 and a pump fire the second. Each timer carries its own trigger's key; both live concurrently after the second pump; the triggers alone remain at the end. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__rules_timed
idris.note: THE INDEPENDENT-TIMERS PROGRAM, lowered: `notify` on the trigger with `after 3: log "{t.entity_id}"` -- the parent emitting the timer with the key captured, and the follow-up on it (logical/LTAC.4.3's and LTAC.5.4_same_tick_order's shape, the log aside). A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__tests_timed
idris.note: The independent-timers program's tests. A fixture.
